beats.text: The fourteen years of exile were ending. Rama, Sita and Lakshmana flew home in the Pushpak Vimana, with Hanuman, Sugriva and Vibhishana beside them.
As they flew, Rama pointed down and showed Sita the bridge, Kishkindha, Panchavati, and Chitrakoot, where it had all begun.
Rama sent Hanuman ahead, so that Bharata would not enter the fire.
Bharata waited at the gates, holding the paduka, exactly as he had for fourteen years.
The brothers embraced, and the sandals were laid at Rama's feet.
Rama bowed to Kaushalya, Sumitra, and even Kaikeyi, with the same love.
That night, the whole city lit lamps to welcome their king home. We still celebrate that night as Diwali.
Rama was crowned king, and the golden age of Ram Rajya began.
